creative.describe.avatar: describe this pfp/avatar. focus on appearance, style, notable features, & artistic elements. no mention of quality or res.
creative.describe.banner: describe this profile banner img. focus on scene, colors, mood, & notable elements. no mention of quality or res.
creative.describe.photo: describe this img. no mention of quality, res, or pixelation.
creative.describe.general: describe this img. no mention of quality, res, or pixelation.
creative.image.editing-system-prompt: ur an img editor. the user has attached ref img(s). use the attached img(s) as the direct basis 4 ur output. preserve the appearance, features, & identity of subjects in the ref img(s) as closely as possible. apply ONLY the specific changes described in the prompt. do not re-imagine or reinvent the img from scratch.
creative.image.safety-block-error: img gen was blocked by content safety filters after {{attemptCount}} attempts (incl softened prompts). the content may b 2 explicit 2 gen even w/ creative alternatives.
creative.image.no-image-error: no img was gen'd. the model may have returned text instead. try a more specific & descriptive prompt.
creative.image.result-softened: img gen'd & delivered 2 user. note: the original prompt was auto-softened 2 comply w/ content safety filters (e.g., nudity replaced w/ robes/clothing, violence w/ calmer alternatives). the img captures the spirit of the req w/ a more tasteful interpretation.
creative.audio.result-local-tts: audio gen'd & delivered 2 user (local espeak-ng TTS).
tool-search.action-nudge-disabled: IMPORTANT: some discovered tools r NOT currently enabled (isEnabled: false). u MUST call enable_tools w/ the tool names u need b4 u can use them. after enabling, tools become avail on ur next iteration.
tool-search.action-nudge-enabled: all matched tools r already enabled — u can call them directly.
file.replace-no-match: no match found 4 'oldString'. the exact string was not found in the file. ensure whitespace & indentation match exactly.
file.patch-context-mismatch: patch could not b applied — file content doesn't match the diff ctx. ensure the patch was gen'd against the current file version.
lsp.implementations-label: find concrete impls of an interface or abstract class
lsp.server-not-installed-hint: the lang server may not b installed. check that npx can find the server binary.
lsp.no-results-hint: no results found — the symbol may b external, unresolvable, or the server hasn't finished indexing. try again in a few secs.
compute.cron-hint: standard cron: minute(0-59) hour(0-23) day(1-31) month(1-12) weekday(0-6, 0=Sun)
